instruction: Muttered mid-thought, unhurried, weary bafflement; trails off without expecting any answer.

Slow, flat satisfaction; the outcome was never once in doubt.
Unhurried, grumbling certainty; the weight sits on "you have to".
Slow, low, half-disgusted; a small pause set before "wicked".
Unhurried, devout and level; no fervour, plain statement of the order.
Slow, quiet respect; a flat verdict that closes the matter.
Unhurried, dismissive but not unkind; winding the conversation quietly down.
Slow, dry, shrugging cynicism; nothing in this world surprises him anymore.
Unhurried, tired relief; thin comfort rather than real conviction.
Slow, flat commiseration; stating a plain fact, not asking for sympathy.
Unhurried, mild encouragement, slightly detached; your problem, not his.
Brisk and sharp, angry but worn thin; snapped once, then done.

Slow, grudging; beaten pride, a real pause after "you win".

Normal pace, weary menace; mocking on "You again", hardening toward the end.
Brisk, roared once, final; no room whatsoever left for talk.

Sharp start, then unhurried and cold straight through the threat.
Normal pace, suspicious challenge; hard call first, then a narrowing demand.
Brisk, startled and instantly alert; strong hit on "THAT".
Unhurried, cold suspicion; second question slower and more accusing than the first.
Normal pace, hard and territorial; flat, allowing no argument.
Brisk, barked twice with full authority; second half harder than first.
Unhurried, dry satisfaction; mild condescension underneath, no gloating at all.
Slow, flat agreement; one grave syllable and nothing more.
Brisk, dismissive anger; waving him off, done with the matter.
Brisk, hard, mid-action; anger released, weapon already coming up.

Brisk, furious promise; low and hard, never a shriek.

Unhurried, quiet approval from a teacher; understated, almost grudging warmth.
